meta.title: Web Search Replacement
meta.description: Run web_search through an independent CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Qoder International or Qoder China account; queries are sent to the selected vendor. OFF returns the official search before any account or network work. Qoder auto mode may issue a second request with extra quota on limited failures; after a network change the old preferred host may fail once before auto-correction. The last successful host is persisted on this machine and preferred after a restart. 0.1.0 has no Fetch and must not run alongside JetHub search takeover; real release acceptance is NOT RUN / PENDING.
